text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use of NLP is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in written words. For example, translation apps use NLP to change text from one language into another quickly. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover if customers feel positive or negative about a product. Chatbots also depend on NLP to communicate with people in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily interaction with technology is becoming easier and more helpful.
